entries.text: Write a haiku about unified memory.
Explain how continuous batching improves LLM serving throughput.

Section 1: Unified memory lets the GPU and CPU share the same address space without an explicit copy. This point matters most when the sequence length is large, because approximation error introduced early in the context can influence every subsequent prediction through the attention mechanism.
